name: Follow The Edict raises the amount of every Edict by 20% (#1899)
contract: Follow The Edict 503698 has E0 aura 108 (SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER), MiscValue 8 (SPELLMOD_ALL_EFFECTS), BasePoints 19 / DieSides 1 = +20%, class mask (0, 0, 0x20000000); its tooltip reads 'Increases the effectiveness of your Edicts by $s1%'. Every Edict record carries SpellFamilyName 21 and SpellFamilyFlags C 0x20000000 (Witching Edict 707687 and 681442 with aura 345 BasePoints 61 -> 62, Greater Inquisitor's Edict 680303 with aura 29 BasePoints 76 -> 77), none has SPELL_ATTR3_IGNORE_CASTER_MODIFIERS, and SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue runs Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers on the base amount, so the percent is delivered by the core with no per-spell code. Expected amounts are DBC arithmetic truncated to int: 62 * 1.2 = 74.4 -> 74, 77 * 1.2 = 92.4 -> 92. Burrow Bolt 802269 (flags C 0x40000000) is the control and must not move.
